name: Camp Narache
summary: Camp Narache is where young tauren begin their training, high on Red Cloud Mesa in southern Mulgore. It is the ancestral home of the Hawkwind tribe. Up here, above the plains, the old traditions are kept. But the camp must always stand guard, against the quilboar and the centaur.

sections.title: Heart of the Hawkwind Tribe
sections.body: The camp stands at the northern edge of the mesa, a village of great hide lodges and pavilions. There is a tent for wounded braves, and a lodge for speaking with the ancestors. At its center, the tribal elders and trainers stand in a circle. Among them is the venerable Greatmother Hawkwind. She still guides the young, as they take up their place as defenders of the Earth Mother.

sections.title: A Proving Ground Under Threat
sections.body: The sheer cliffs of the mesa make a natural fortress, yet the camp knows little peace. Bristleback quilboar press in from Brambleblade Ravine, and centaur scouts linger in the distance. Here young hunters, shaman, druids and warriors prove their mettle. They cull the angry wildlife, guard the village well and turn back the quilboar raiders. Then they walk the great path down, into the wider valleys of Mulgore.

faq.answer: Young tauren begin their training at Camp Narache, atop Red Cloud Mesa in southern Mulgore. The camp is the Hawkwind tribe’s main settlement, where hunters, warriors, druids, and shamans learn their crafts before traveling to Bloodhoof Village and Thunder Bluff. The lodges store weapons and bake bread.
Greatmother Hawkwind guides the tribe alongside Chief Hawkwind, who leads the braves and coordinates the mesa’s defenses. The elders and trainers gather at the camp’s center to instruct the young.

faq.q: What threats does the camp face?
faq.answer: Bristleback quilboar from Brambleblade Ravine to the east harass the camp. Battleboars and striders roam the surrounding bluffs, and centaur bands remain a threat.

faq.q: Can travelers easily leave the mesa?
faq.answer: Steep cliffs bound Red Cloud Mesa, and a guarded mountain path leads north into Mulgore’s plains. Hawkwind braves watch the way to keep hostile beasts and quilboar from ambushing travelers.

angles.text: As a tauren, you begin your rites of the hunt on this sacred earth and attune yourself to ancestral spirits under the Hawkwind elders’ watch.
As a young shaman, you take your first steps on the spiritual path here, facing trials to earn your Earth Totem and speak with the mesa’s elementals.
